assumptions: The manuscript's 55-second mean passage time is interpreted as one independent arrival event per active tag per mean passage interval across the modeled cell.
Arrival events are split uniformly across 60 poles. This is a synthetic spatial approximation, not a route trace.
The baseline sends each arrival record as its own uplink and sends one raw 4-byte-ID list per pole per heartbeat interval.
The proposed case batches up to 25 eight-byte records at each pole every 15 seconds and sends one fixed 64-byte application heartbeat per pole every 60 seconds.

Packets use independent uniform channel selection and the scenario-specific event timing; any same-channel airtime overlap destroys all overlapping packets. No capture, retries, duty-cycle enforcement, SF diversity, or RF measurements are modeled.

The traffic model runs 40 independent deterministic seeds. Its 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles describe run-to-run stochastic variation under this configured scenario; they do not represent uncertainty in assumptions or measured shrine traffic.
